description: This file contains a PHP class named 'Account' which is part of the OpenCart extension modules for the catalog controller. The class manages the account page, preparing data such as URLs and customer login status, and renders a view for the account module.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling the account module view, including building URLs for various account-related pages and checking customer login status.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Builds data array with URLs and login status, then renders the account module view.
